lines.t: Oh Lord, I don’t wanna walk without You
Or let these days just pass me by
Knowing all the words to say about You
But never knowing what is on Your mind
I wanna come to You with nothing hidden
No perfect words, no heart disguised
Just a longing that won’t let me settle
For a distant picture of Your light
Teach me how to listen
Help me learn Your ways
Let me find You in the quiet
Not just in my hardest days
I wanna be devoted
I wanna know Your heart
Feel Your sadness, share Your joy
Understand how good You are
I don’t wanna go through life
And keep Your love so far
YahuShua, draw me closer
Show me who You are
What makes You smile? What brings You sorrow
Teach me to love without expecting
Something I can hold or give right back
I wanna understand Your righteousness
Not turn away when truth is hard
Let the things I learn about You
Let the things I learn about You
Change the way I give my heart
I wanna be devoted
I wanna know Your heart
Feel Your sadness, share Your joy
Understand how good You are
I don’t wanna go through life
And keep Your love so far
YahuShua, draw me closer
Show me who You are
When You speak, help me listen
When You lead, help me move
When Your way is not what I wanted
Let me still reach out for You
Not just for what You can give me
Not just to carry me through
More than answers, more than blessings
Lord, I wanna walk with You
I wanna be devoted
I wanna know Your heart
Feel Your sadness, share Your joy
Let Your goodness shape my heart
I don’t wanna go through life
Without knowing who You are
YahuShua, draw me closer
Show me who You are
All my days, keep drawing closer
Let me love You as I learn
YahuShua, I wanna know You
Show me who You are
